name: Derby Summer Programs
description_short: Half-day summer programs (9:00 AM–12:00 PM) at Derby Academy in Hingham in four tracks: Camp Derby, Arts, STEM and Sports. Families can pay extra for an Extended Day through 4:00 PM that includes lunch and two more classes.

warnings: This is a program overview page. It has no session dates, prices or ages. Details are probably on the linked Camp Derby, Summer Arts, Summer STEM, Summer Sports and Tuition and Financial Aid pages.

The footer line 'Pre-K through Grade 8' describes Derby Academy's school, not necessarily the camp's age range, so no ages were recorded.
Lunch is included only with the paid Extended Day add-on, so meals_included was left blank.
